segments.narration: Flakes of raw meat rained from a clear sky. In 1876, a Kentucky farm was pelted by a two-minute shower of flesh.
segments.visual_keywords: sunny blue sky over green farm field

segments.narration: It covered an area ninety feet long. Two brave locals actually tasted it, insisting it was fresh venison.
segments.visual_keywords: vintage wooden house in rural countryside

segments.narration: Scientists rushed samples to labs nationwide. How did butchered meat end up in the clouds?
segments.visual_keywords: old vintage microscope in dark laboratory

segments.narration: Vulture regurgitation is considered the leading theory, but the exact cause remains an unsolved mystery.
segments.visual_keywords: vultures flying overhead in bright sky

segments.narration: So those brave Kentucky locals didn't taste manna from heaven—they ate regurgitated buzzard dinner.
segments.visual_keywords: sunset over quiet rural country road

verdicts.claim: In March 1876, a shower of raw meat fell over a farm in Bath County, Kentucky.
verdicts.note: The article states that on March 3, 1876, chunks of meat fell from the sky near Olympia Springs on the farm of Mrs. Crouch in Bath County, Kentucky.

verdicts.claim: Two local residents tasted the fallen meat and believed it was venison or mutton.
verdicts.note: The article notes that according to Scientific American, two men tasted the meat and judged it to be lamb (mutton) or deer (venison).

verdicts.claim: Samples of the meat were sent to scientists and laboratories for official analysis.
verdicts.note: The article confirms that samples were sent to chemists, microscopists, and scientific associations (such as the Newark Scientific Association) in Kentucky, Ohio, and New York.

verdicts.claim: Scientists concluded the meat was regurgitated by a flock of vultures startled mid-flight.
verdicts.note: The article states that vulture regurgitation is the leading theory and most plausible explanation, but the exact cause and precise circumstances of the event remain a subject of speculation and mystery.
verdicts.correction: Vulture regurgitation is considered the leading theory, but the exact cause remains an unsolved mystery.

verdicts.claim: Microscopic examination confirmed the substance was animal lung and muscle tissue.
verdicts.note: Microscopic analysis identified samples as mammalian lung tissue, muscle, cartilage, and connective tissue.
